answers.question: Which distinct car models are the produced after 1980?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT DISTINCT model FROM car_names WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM cars_data WHERE year > 1980)

answers.question: How many car makers are there in each continents? List the continent name and the count.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT c continent_name FROM continents c

answers.question: Which of the countries has the most car makers? List the country name.
answers.generated_answer: SELECT countryname FROM countries WHERE countryid IN (SELECT country FROM car_makers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

answers.question: What are all the makers and models?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT cm.make, cm.model FROM model_list cm

answers.question: What are the names and ids of all countries with at least one car maker?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT countryid, countryname FROM countries WHERE countryid IN (SELECT country FROM car_makers)

answers.question: What is the number of the cars with horsepower more than 150?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cars_data WHERE horsepower > 150

answers.question: What is the average weight and year for each year?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT AVG(weight), year FROM cars_data GROUP BY year

answers.question: Which countries in europe have at least 3 car manufacturers?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cm.id) AS manufacturer_count FROM car_makers cm JOIN countries c ON cm.country = c.countryid WHERE c.continent = 'Europe' GROUP BY c.countryid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cm.id) >= 3

answers.question: What is the maximum horsepower and the make of the car models with 3 cylinders?
answers.generated_answer: SELECT MAX(horsepower), make FROM cars_data INNER JOIN car_names ON (car_names.makeid = cars_data.id) WHERE cylinders = 3 GROUP BY make

answers.question: What is the average horsepower of the cars before 1980?
